'''Pietra''' (Japanese: '''エリコ''' ''Eriko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP204|Right On, Rhydon!]]''. She also appeared in [[Ash & Pikachu]].

==In animation==
[[Pietra's grandmother]] sprained her ankle and Pietra wanted to make it easier for her to travel through the mountain by digging a tunnel through it. She was using {{type|Ground}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} to try to achieve this. As they dug deeper, water began to drip onto them, which caused the Ground-types to be scared off. As a result, she resolved to catch a certain {{p|Rhydon}} which was able to use {{m|Surf}} and as such, wasn't afraid of water.

Pietra met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, and together, they came across Rhydon. It escaped into the lake, however. Ash and {{an|Misty}} used their {{t|Water}} Pokémon to help search for it. Pietra used her speedboat to go out onto the lake. Soon, {{AP|Totodile}} discovered Rhydon by accident and bit on its horn, angering it. Pietra tried to {{pkmn|battle}} it, but was unsuccessful after it used {{m|Horn Drill}} in the water and caused a whirlpool.

They then traveled over to a small island where they saw Rhydon coming to shore. Pietra encountered it again, but {{TRT}} interfered and tried to take it for themselves. Ash assisted in stopping them and the Rhydon jumped back into the lake. Pietra jumped into the lake after it and latched onto it. Rhydon carried her under water, but she refused to let go until it battled her, and eventually the Rhydon finally gave in and agreed.

She used her {{p|Marill}} to battle and defeat Rhydon, which allowed her to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} it. She then used her newly caught Rhydon to complete the tunnel.

|desc=Pietra wanted this {{p|Rhydon}} because of its ability to use Surf and her need for a surfing Pokémon that would ensure easier travel for her. Unlike most of her Ground-type Pokémon, Rhydon wasn't afraid of water. It is considered to be very strong as it knocked out many Pokémon that tried to {{pkmn|battle}} it. It was a reclusive [[wild Pokémon]] and would only attack others when threatened. It was particularly fond of apples, and this helped Pietra eventually track it down.

After witnessing Pietra's determination, Rhydon eventually conceded and agreed to battle Pietra. Rhydon went up against Pietra's {{p|Marill}}, and it was able to use its Horn Drill to block effective {{t|Water}} attacks. However, a swing of Marill's {{m|Iron Tail}} weakened Rhydon enough for Pietra to catch Rhydon on her second attempt. It later helped Pietra complete her tunneling project.

Rhydon's known moves are {{m|Surf}}, {{m|Horn Drill}}, and {{m|Take Down}}.}}
